schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sinistres (
    numero_sinistre                  VARCHAR(20)      NOT NULL,
    annee_sinistre                   SMALLINT         NOT NULL,
    pays                             VARCHAR(100)     NOT NULL,
    branche                          VARCHAR(50)      NOT NULL,
    origine_sinistre                 VARCHAR(255),
    dommage_estime_eur               NUMERIC(18,2),
    reserve_actuelle_eur             NUMERIC(18,2),
    ecart_reserve_dommage_eur        NUMERIC(18,2)    GENERATED ALWAYS AS (dommage_estime_eur - reserve_actuelle_eur) STORED,
    statut_procedure                 VARCHAR(60),
    orientation_resolution           VARCHAR(60),
    revision_reserve                 VARCHAR(100),
    frais_defense_integres           BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    coassurance                      BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    risque_partage_multiples_porteurs BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    declaration_tardive              BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    arret_production                 BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    activite_interrompue_durablement BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    pertes_exploitation              BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    atteintes_corporelles            BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    action_groupee_victimes          BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    reclamations_multiples_tiers     BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    responsabilite_sous_traitant     BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sous_assurance                   BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    regle_proportionnelle            BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    contestation_exclusion           BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    divergence_experts               BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    suspicion_fraude                 BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    faute_inexcusable_employeur      BOOLEAN          NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    points_attention                 TEXT,
    date_mise_a_jour                 DATE,
    CONSTRAINT pk_sinistres PRIMARY KEY (numero_sinistre),
    CONSTRAINT chk_branche CHECK (branche IN ('Cyber','Dommages industriels','Environnement','Aviation','Maritime','Construction','RC produits','RC générale')),
    CONSTRAINT chk_statut CHECK (statut_procedure IN ('aucune action','règlement amiable','transaction en cours','assignation judiciaire','procédure judiciaire en cours','contentieux'))
);

schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sinistres (
    numero_sinistre          VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
    date_sinistre            DATE,
    annee_sinistre           SMALLINT       NOT NULL,
    pays                     VARCHAR(100)   NOT NULL,
    branche                  VARCHAR(100)   NOT NULL,
    origine_sinistre         VARCHAR(255)   NOT NULL,
    dommage_estime_eur       NUMERIC(18,2),
    reserve_actuelle_eur     NUMERIC(18,2),
    ecart_reserve_dommage_eur NUMERIC(18,2) GENERATED ALWAYS AS (dommage_estime_eur - reserve_actuelle_eur) STORED,
    ratio_reserve_dommage    NUMERIC(8,4)   GENERATED ALWAYS AS (CASE WHEN dommage_estime_eur <> 0 THEN reserve_actuelle_eur / dommage_estime_eur END) STORED,
    frais_defense_integres   BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    revision_reserve         VARCHAR(50)    CHECK (revision_reserve IN ('rapport_expertise','devis_reconstruction','frais_defense_ajoutes','aucune_revision')),
    statut_procedure         VARCHAR(50)    NOT NULL DEFAULT 'aucune_action'
                                            CHECK (statut_procedure IN ('aucune_action','negociation_amiable','transaction_en_cours','assignation_delivree','contentieux_engage','arbitrage','mediation')),
    coassurance              BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    nombre_coassureurs       SMALLINT       NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (nombre_coassureurs >= 0),
    victimes_corporelles     BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    action_groupee_envisagee BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    tiers_leses_multiples    BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sous_traitant_implique   BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    faute_inexcusable_invoquee BOOLEAN      NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    exclusion_contestee      BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    exclusion_ambigue        BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    declaration_tardive      BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sous_assurance           BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    desaccord_experts        BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    arret_production         BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    pertes_exploitation      BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    enquete_fraude           BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    contrepartie_sanctionnee BOOLEAN        NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    points_attention         TEXT,
    CONSTRAINT pk_sinistres PRIMARY KEY (numero_sinistre),
    CONSTRAINT chk_coassurance CHECK (coassurance = TRUE OR nombre_coassureurs = 0),
    CONSTRAINT chk_annee CHECK (annee_sinistre BETWEEN 1900 AND 2100)
);

schema.ddl:
CREATE TABLE sinistres (
    numero_dossier              VARCHAR(20)     NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
    date_sinistre               DATE            NOT NULL,
    pays                        VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL,
    branche                     VARCHAR(100)    NOT NULL,
    origine_sinistre            VARCHAR(255)    NOT NULL,

    -- Financier
    dommage_estime_eur          NUMERIC(18,2)   NOT NULL,
    reserve_actuelle_eur        NUMERIC(18,2)   NOT NULL,
    ecart_reserve_eur           NUMERIC(18,2)   GENERATED ALWAYS AS (dommage_estime_eur - reserve_actuelle_eur) STORED,
    reserve_insuffisante        BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    revision_reserve_effectuee  BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    motif_revision_reserve      VARCHAR(255),
    frais_defense_integres      BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Situation juridique
    statut_contentieux          VARCHAR(50)     NOT NULL
                                    CHECK (statut_contentieux IN (
                                        'aucune action',
                                        'negociation amiable',
                                        'transaction en cours',
                                        'assignation delivree',
                                        'procedure judiciaire'
                                    )),
    action_judiciaire_engagee   BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    declaration_tardive         BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Garanties / contrat
    exclusion_contestee         BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    ambiguite_exclusion         BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    sous_assurance              BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    regle_proportionnelle_applicable BOOLEAN    NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Expertise
    divergence_experts          BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Victimes / tiers
    atteintes_corporelles       BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    faute_inexcusable_evoquee   BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    tiers_leses_multiples       BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Exploitation
    pertes_exploitation         BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    arret_production_semaines   SMALLINT        CHECK (arret_production_semaines >= 0),

    -- Coassurance
    coassurance                 BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    nombre_coassureurs          SMALLINT        CHECK (nombre_coassureurs >= 0),

    -- Responsabilité tiers
    sous_traitant_implique      BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    fraude_suspectee            BOOLEAN         NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,

    -- Gestion
    gestionnaire_dossier        VARCHAR(150),

    CONSTRAINT chk_coassureurs_coherence
        CHECK (coassurance = TRUE OR nombre_coassureurs IS NULL),
    CONSTRAINT chk_motif_revision_coherence
        CHECK (revision_reserve_effectuee = TRUE OR motif_revision_reserve IS NULL),
    CONSTRAINT chk_arret_production_coherence
        CHECK (pertes_exploitation = TRUE OR arret_production_semaines IS NULL)
);
